story.fullStory:
Bruno Mars's "Uptown Funk Old Movie Stars Dancing 2014" — original release 2015. "Uptown Funk" is a song by British-American  DJ and record producer Mark Ronson featuring American singer Bruno Mars.

It was released on 10 November 2014, as the lead single from Ronson's fourth studio album, Uptown Special (2015).

"Uptown Funk" was written by Ronson, Mars, Jeff Bhasker, and Philip Lawrence; it was produced by the aforementioned first three.
